annotation.title_clean: European Parliament resolution of 26 November 2025 on the protection of minors online (2025/2060(INI))
annotation.title_en: European Parliament resolution of 26 November 2025 on the protection of minors online (2025/2060(INI))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series, C/2026/1708)
named_instruments_referenced: UN Convention on the Rights of the Child
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament own-initiative resolution on protecting minors online. It urges stronger DSA enforcement, a harmonised digital age limit of 16, privacy-preserving age verification, bans on addictive design, loot boxes and kidfluencer monetisation, and AI Act enforcement for chatbots and companions. It briefly notes AI toys as high-risk under the Toy Safety Regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a harmonised EU digital age limit of 16 (13 absolute minimum) for social media, with parental authorisation option
Calls for privacy-preserving, non-linkable age verification via the EU age-verification app and eID Wallet
Urges legislation banning engagement-based recommender systems and addictive design for minors, and prohibiting loot boxes
Calls for stricter AI Act enforcement on manipulative chatbots and AI companions, and safeguards against human-like features
Notes AI-enabled toys are high-risk AI under the Toy Safety Regulation requiring third-party conformity assessment
